title: TrimMask trimmed-shell IGA: revision data and qualified runtime
description:
Curated data and runtime supporting the revised trimmed-shell IGA study: current separate figure panels, table observations, complete displacement and face-stress fields, actual IGA/FEM geometries, five native engineering models, independent geometric/MMS/interface-work/refinement/quadrature evidence, plotting sources and the qualified AutoCAD2025 CoreConsole runtime.

Includes83 unchanged scientific plotting inputs and the complete physical flags/profiles required by the recorded runtime cases. Unfavorable strong-flux, finite-reference and stress controls retain their original status. No new numerical replay is claimed. Redundant native ODB databases, full solver-capture archives and private manuscript/authoring history are omitted.

Project materials remain All rights reserved under the repository LICENSE. Separate third-party notices accompany the runtime.
notes: Publicly downloadable research data/runtime. All rights reserved: https://github.com/yaluji123/TrimMask-trimmed-shell-IGA/blob/main/LICENSE. No new open-source grant. Separate Clipper2, Eigen and Intel notices remain with their components.
